articles.title: Zcash seals $1.7 billion shielded pool as Ironwood upgrade activates
articles.snippet: The upgrade retires Orchard, where a counterfeiting bug sat undetected for four years. Every coin inside now has to leave through a gate that caps withdrawals at verified deposits.

articles.title: Binance makes fighting crypto crime more difficult, says new report
articles.snippet: The New York Times says a quiet change to Binance's compliance rules is forcing international law enforcement to navigate slow-moving government treaties to get user data.

articles.title: Inside the CME and CFTC’s battle over onchain perpetual futures
articles.snippet: Weeks ago, the U.S. CFTC opened the gates for crypto perps with its first listing approval, but major derivatives player CME is fighting back against what it sees as a diversion from the law.

articles.title: Rate path still divides investors: Five things to know in Bitcoin this week
articles.snippet: Bitcoin traders prepared to navigate a slew of volatility catalysts as US inflation data and US-Iran war triggers keep risk-assets in an unpredictable state.

articles.title: Nvidia, Microsoft and IBM Launch Open Secure AI Alliance to Strengthen AI Cybersecurity
articles.snippet: More than 40 technology companies and organizations have allied to develop open-source AI security tools and standards for cyber defense.
